subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 12, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 12, 2026. Welcome to this week's edition of the AcreetionOS newsletter. We've had some exciting developments across our ecosystem today, bringing us closer to a more stable and feature-rich operating system. Our community continues to grow and innovate together.

On the development front, the team has made significant progress on the core AcreetionOS codebase. The latest merge of the repair branch addressed critical geocode-glib update conflicts that were impacting several installations. These changes ensure compatibility across different system configurations while maintaining our commitment to privacy and performance.

Beyond the immediate fixes, we've also been working on improving the Calamares installer for smoother first-time experiences. New configuration options have been added to make the installation process more accessible for new users. Additionally, the kernel team has released two stable updates that bring important security patches and performance improvements to the rolling release cycle.

Our community remains vibrant with active contributions and collaborative spirit. Several members have shared their insights on system optimization techniques and best practices for running AcreetionOS on various hardware configurations. The Discord channel has seen increased engagement as developers and enthusiasts connect to discuss upcoming features and provide feedback.

Recent community activities include the publication of EuroPython 2026 video recordings and discussions around the latest kernel releases. The security team has also issued updates addressing vulnerabilities in common dependencies, ensuring our platform stays secure against emerging threats. These efforts reflect our ongoing dedication to providing a safe and reliable computing environment.
